name: Activation guard / face-down Skybody Keikoi still activates
notes: Enigma legally equips Mystic Skybody Keikoi face-down via Cloaked. Its printed instant can be activated while face-down under CR1.7.4b/5.2.4. At non-turn AP0 during ATTACK, destruction is paid before the layer resolves; no resources/AP are paid. The resolved effect prevents the next1 damage this turn, so unblocked first Wounding Blow blue2 deals1, leaving19. This preserves the ARC hidden-ability exception despite HasNoAbilities treating hidden equipment specially.
